scripts.test: sh -c 'for argument in "$@"; do case "$argument" in --reporter=junit|--outputFile=*) ;; -*) echo "client test accepts only file paths plus --reporter=junit and --outputFile=<path>; other options and interactive modes are not supported by this functional entrypoint" >&2; exit 2;; esac; done; functional_pattern=$(NODE_V8_COVERAGE= node ../.github/scripts/capacity-runner.mjs client-pattern) && [ -n "$functional_pattern" ] && exec vitest run --testNamePattern="$functional_pattern" "$@"' --
scripts.test:watch: sh -c 'echo "test:watch is disabled because interactive filters can include capacity cases; use npm test --workspace client -- <file paths>" >&2; exit 2' --
scripts.test:coverage: sh -c 'functional_pattern=$(NODE_V8_COVERAGE= node ../.github/scripts/capacity-runner.mjs client-pattern) && [ -n "$functional_pattern" ] && { if [ "$#" -eq 1 ] && [ "$1" = "--testNamePattern=$functional_pattern" ]; then shift; fi; [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { echo "client test:coverage accepts no arguments except the exact existing CI catalog pattern" >&2; exit 2; }; exec vitest run --coverage --testNamePattern="$functional_pattern"; }' --
